A retrospective study5 found that the choles- terol-lowering effect of simvastatin was greater in patients who were also receiving diltiazem, and there have also been reports6-8 of rhabdomyolysis, associated with hepatitis in 1 case,6 in pa- tients receiving simvastatin and diltiazem together. Rhabdomyolysis8,9 and hepatitis9 have also been reported in pa- tients receiving atorvastatin with diltiazem. 1. Kantola T, et al.
